scientific_integrity: The mathematical proof provides a complete integer-interval classification; finite exhaustive computations are corroboration, not the basis for extrapolating an infinite theorem. The literature comparison is qualified and independent scientific validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Binary sources of weight exactly two, full letter/pair decks with position gap at least s; exact formulas only for n >= 3s-1 and the immediately preceding n. No assertion for smaller n, larger word weights, or noisy reconstruction.
title: Sharp linear capacity of weight-two gapped pair decks at every spacing
